message: I remember a time when a storm rolled in, and I gathered the grandkids with some popcorn and a few blankets. We turned off the lights and pretended we were in a cozy little cabin, listening to the thunder rumble. It’s always good to know how to stay safe during storms, and this resource has some handy tips to help you prepare—just in case you find yourself in a similar cozy situation. So, grab a snack and maybe a good book, and let the storm be your backdrop for a little adventure! ☔
